chart.title: Accumulated cyclone energy of North Atlantic hurricanes
chart.subtitle: Accumulated cyclone energy (ACE) is an index used to measure the activity of a cyclone/hurricane season. It combines the number of hurricane systems, how long they existed and how intense they became.
chart.citation: HURDAT, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (2024)
